assignments.reason: רפואה (healing) shares the essential nature of Package 1, which already contains תקון החולה (healing of the sick). The Rebbe explicitly states 'וְהַשִּׂמְחָה הִוא רְפוּאָה גְּדוֹלָה' — simcha IS a great healing — using identity language that places רפואה squarely within the domain of joy-as-healing. While the extracted edge (שמחה → רפואה) is typed as eitza (simcha produces healing), the concept of רפואה itself belongs to the same essential domain as תקון החולה: both are expressions of the curative reality that defines this package. Healing is not a separate domain from 'healing of the sick' — it is the same thing stated in its general form.
